description.en:
DR01 is DEEP Robotics' humanoid research platform for embodied intelligence and dynamic locomotion. Its control approach combines information about the robot's own motion with perception of the surrounding terrain, allowing learning-based policies to adapt movement to uneven surfaces and disturbances.

The manufacturer reports walking demonstrations above 1.6 m/s, steps of 18 cm and slopes of 25 degrees, alongside recovery from external pushes and slippery conditions. These are platform demonstrations with specific operating conditions. DR01 is intended to support AI training, behavior development and exploration of future industrial and domestic applications, building on DEEP Robotics' work in legged motion and proprietary joint hardware.
